body.title: Krum, the Library: Automated Byzantine Machine Learning Experiments on Python with Orchestration
body.authors: Sébastien Rouault, Arthur Danjou, Mohamad-Ammar Said, Peva Blanchard and El Mahdi El Mhamdi
body.description: An open-source Python/PyTorch framework with 11 aggregation rules, 5 attacks, 4 data partitioners, 6 model architectures and 3 protocol-faithful simulations (NIPS 2017, ICML 2018, ICML 2023 MoNNA), plus a programmatic orchestrator with typed metrics and replay-after-change. Released v0.9.0 on PyPI under MIT.
